create_protocol_node: create a ProtocolNode that manages experiment trials using a priority queue and labgraph topics
setup_protocol_node: setup a ProtocolNode by importing a module and initializing the priority queue and experiment state
publish_current_trial: publish the current trial on CURRENT_TRIAL_TOPIC as a timestamped CurrentTrialMessage when ready
subscribe_ready_topic: subscribe to READY_TOPIC messages to set the node ready state for publishing new trials
end_trial_subscriber: subscribe to END_TRIAL_TOPIC to record trial results and mark the node ready for the next trial
